The rendering process computes expected color and depth along rays $r(t) = o + td$ using sample points $t_i$ with weights $w_i = T(t_i)\rho(t_i)$, where $\rho(t_i) = 1 - \exp(-\sigma(\mathbf{r}(t_i))(t_{i+1} - t_i))$ and $T(t_i) = \prod_{j=1}^{i-1} (1 - \rho(t_j))$ [7475-geometric-baseline-regularization.md].
where $w_i = T_i (1 - \exp(-\sigma_i \delta_i))$ are the rendering weights, $t_i$ are sample depths, and $T_i$ is the accumulated transmittance [7475-geometric-baseline-regularization.md].
